title: Long-Term Commitment Credit on Maximum-Term Extensions — Domain Registrations
content:
**Pricing desk ruling.** A maximum-term extension of a Domain Registrations domain carries the maximum-term term credit, one of the maximum-term credits, which rewards the length of the extension. The maximum-term term credit is USD 0.60 times the maximum-term years where they come to 5 or more, the flat USD 1.00 where they come to 2 to 4, and nothing where they come to 1.

The ruling turns on the maximum-term years of the extension alone: an extension of 2, 3 or 4 maximum-term years earns USD 1.00 whatever its length within that band; from 5 maximum-term years the credit is USD 0.60 for every one of those years, so 5 years earn USD 3.00, 8 years USD 4.80 and 9 years USD 5.40; a single maximum-term year earns nothing.

| Maximum-term years | 1 | 2 to 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Term credit (USD) | nothing | 1.00 | 3.00 | 3.60 | 4.20 | 4.80 | 5.40 |

The step between 4 and 5 years is the only boundary: 4 years earn USD 1.00, 5 years earn USD 3.00.
